CREATE_DATABASE_QUERY: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS pocketsmart
CREATE_USERS_TABLE_QUERY: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user (user_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, full_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, phone_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
DROP_COUNTRY_CODE_COLUMN_QUERY: ALTER TABLE user DROP COLUMN country_code
CREATE_ONBOARDING_TABLE_QUERY: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (account_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL UNIQUE, allowance_amount VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, allowance_frequency VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, current_balance VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, cycle_limit VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, last_refreshed TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES user(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
CREATE_GOALS_TABLE_QUERY: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS goals (goal_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, target_amount VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, time_to_reach INT NOT NULL, progress INT DEFAULT 0, priority INT DEFAULT 3, is_active TINYINT DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES user(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
CREATE_TRANSACTIONS_TABLE_QUERY: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions (transaction_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL, merchant VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, date VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, icon VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, month_label VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, avoidable TINYINT DEFAULT 0, reason VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES user(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
